_comment: Same shape/rules as exams-rrb-test-config.json (see its _comment) — keys match exams-ssc.json ids. SSC moved several exams to strict per-section timing starting the 2026 cycle, so 'sectional' is more common here than on the RRB side.

ssc-cgl-tier1.title: SSC CGL — Tier I
ssc-cgl-tier1.source: 2026 pattern change: each of the 4 sections now gets its own locked 15-minute timer (25 Q/section, 60 min total) — you can no longer move time between sections (SSC official notification, confirmed by multiple 2026 sources)

ssc-cgl-tier2.title: SSC CGL — Tier II
ssc-cgl-tier2.source: 2026 pattern confirms Tier II Paper I also has per-section locked timing (Section I: Maths+Reasoning, Section II: English+GA, Section III has the Data Entry module), but this session's search did not turn up the exact per-section minute split — the group minutes below are a reasonable placeholder only. Verify against the current-cycle official notification before relying on this for real timing practice.

ssc-chsl-tier1.title: SSC CHSL — Tier I
ssc-chsl-tier1.source: Traditionally a 60-minute composite paper (100 Q, all sections share one pool) — this session's search did not turn up an equivalent sectional-timing change for CHSL like the one confirmed for CGL Tier I, but SSC has been rolling that pattern out exam-by-exam, so double-check the live notification for the cycle you're targeting.

ssc-chsl-tier2.title: SSC CHSL — Tier II
ssc-chsl-tier2.source: Single-session composite paper covering the objective sections; not independently re-confirmed this session.

ssc-cpo-tier1.title: SSC CPO — Paper I
ssc-cpo-tier1.source: Historically a 60-minute composite paper (200 Q across 4 sections) — not re-confirmed this session, verify before relying on it.

ssc-gd.title: SSC GD Constable
ssc-gd.source: Single-tier composite paper, 60 minutes is the commonly cited current duration — not independently re-confirmed this session.

ssc-mts.title: SSC MTS / Havaldar
ssc-mts.source: Current pattern is a single composite session covering all sections together — not independently re-confirmed this session.

ssc-je.title: SSC JE
ssc-je.source: Paper I composite — not independently re-confirmed this session.
